episodes.name: Take Me Home
episodes.overviewEn: Determined to complete her newest armored suit, Riri Williams teams up with Parker Robbins.
episodes.overviewAr: تنضم "ريري ويليامز" إلى فريق "باركر روبنز" عاقدة العزم على إكمال بناء بدلتها المدرعة الجديدة.

episodes.name: Will the Real Natalie Please Stand Up?
episodes.overviewEn: Riri's new A.I. dredges up painful memories ahead of her first heist with Parker and his crew.
episodes.overviewAr: يستحضر الذكاء الاصطناعي الجديد لـ"ريري" ذكريات مؤلمة قبل عملية سرقتها الأولى مع "باركر" وطاقمه.

episodes.name: We in Danger, Girl
episodes.overviewEn: Riri is uncomfortable being part of Parker's crew—two more heists, max, and she's out, she promises.
episodes.overviewAr: لا تشعر "ريري" بالارتياح لأنها في طاقم "باركر"، فتتعهد بأنها ستتركهم بعد عمليتي سطو أخريين كحد أقصى.

episodes.name: Bad Magic
episodes.overviewEn: When Parker suspects Riri of wrongdoing, she knows she has to figure out the source of his powers.

episodes.name: Karma's a Glitch
episodes.overviewEn: Riri sets out to create a suit unlike anything she has ever attempted—but at what cost?

episodes.name: The Past Is the Past
episodes.overviewEn: Riri builds her most powerful suit yet, but she's unsure if it's enough to beat Parker and The Hood.
